items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free gentle cleanser is all a young face needs to wash away the day.
A simple ceramide moisturizer helps keep skin comfortable after washing without any active ingredients.

response.routine_note: Wash your face gently with lukewarm water once or twice a day, pat dry, then smooth on a small amount of moisturizer. Skip exfoliating products and strong actives at this age, and ask a parent to help choose a sunscreen for sunny days.
